body:
From tackling personal decisions to reaching important milestones, my job is to guide you on the path of sustainability towards success. I have PhD in Biology and 28 years of experience in progressively senior levels of responsibility at universities and international environmental organizations. As a professional Senior Environmental Consultant, I guarantee great results.

I’m offering services in leading environmental non-profits, programme and project management and environmental research. I’m fueled by my commitment to excellence and go the extra mile to make sure clients are fully satisfied with my work. Get in touch with me today for a free consultation.
services:
Leadership

The Path to Success

I have proven capacity to lead complex organizations and mobilize resources. I am offering ability to build trust, manage, guide and motivate a large and diversified body of staff in a multicultural environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity. Contact me today to discover how I can help.

Project Management

Exercising Excellence

I managed 100+ projects with portfolio of over 50 million EUR. Have a specific project that requires professional attention? My services are designed to tackle even the most complex projects. I also provide customized solutions to all of my clients, and I am an extremely results-oriented professional. Contact me to find out how I can help today.

Environmental Research

A Comprehensive Approach

My clients are my number one priority. I am offering unique tools and experience needed for research in nature resource management, biodiversity, water management, environmental security, local environmental action planning, stakeholder’s analysis and participation. Contact me today to discover how I can help.
recommendations:
Radoje is a dedicated professional that approaches the tasks set before him in a structured and professional manner. He is able to work in challenging circumstances and still be able to deliver high quality outputs prepared by himself and his team. Radoje cooperates well with other actors and keeps abreast of developments in the project he was managing. He is also a good Communicator who is able to rally support behind the project often utilising a range of tools and approaches.

Dr Anders Jägerskog, Senior Water Resources Management Specialist at the World Bank

I was in touch with Radoje several times during my professional careers. Back in 2002, as Regional Manager for Eastern Europe in American Quality and Environmental Group (AQE Group) I enjoyed communication with him while he was a trainee ISO 14000. He distinguished himself with excellent communication skills, effective public speaking and presentation skills, and pronounced complex problem solving and critical thinking. I was also following his career in the Regional Environmental Center (REC), where he demonstrated advanced management and coordination skills and fully target orientation. I also know him as one of the most knowledgeable person in environmental and sustainable development issues. Radoje could be a valuable asset to a company team striving to build sustainable communities, and support initiatives that reduce company’s environmental footprint.

Ilija Djekic, Associate Professor at University of Belgrade - Faculty of Agriculture

Radoje Lausevic is one of the most experienced people in the field of sustainability, climate change and the environment in the wider Europe but also the world. He combines leadership and vision with practical approaches that work in the realities of everyday life of institutions, governments and wider stakeholders. He is a very experienced and professional manager, capable over overseeing a wide range of issues, including programme development and implementation, and donor-relationships. Radoje is an excellent negotiator, result-driven and with his eyes always on the ball. He has proven wide experience as project director of multimillion projects and can think out-of-the box.

Rob Wolters, Executive Director ECNC and Chief Executive ECNC Land & Sea Group

Radoje is a highly professional person with excellent knowledge in development issues. He demonstrates ability to conduct policy dialogue at government and non-goverment levels with high sense of objectivity and professional integrity. Radoje has excellent project management skills and works well under pressure and short deadlines. He was continuously delivering high quality outputs on the projects he was managing. He also confirmed himself as very efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results. He speaks and writes clearly and efficiently. I am highly recommending Radoje.

Kristina Salomonsson, Human Security Adviser / Focal point Latin America at Sida

I know Radoje for quite some time. He was my teaching assistant during my study at the Faculty of Biology. Then we cooperated when I was working for Sida - he was a regional director of REC and this organization implemented project of Swedish support to environmental civil society organizations in the WB region. Most recently, I had the pleasure of working with Radoje during the implementation of the Marine Biodiversity Conservation Center 'Boka Aquarium' (MonteAqua) project, funded by the Norwegian Embassy in Belgrade and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development of Montenegro. As project manager, Radoje demonstrated strong leadership, ensuring achieving the agreed objectives. Under this project, the first public aquarium in Montenegro was established, along with a rescue center for endangered marine animals, contributing to both biodiversity conservation and tourism development. Radoje has excellent coordination and communication skills, and he was instrumental in attracting other donors to join the effort of creating larger and lasting impact. I highly recommend Radoje for any future environmental and marine conservation endeavors.

Nela Jović, Development worker
